Hero.title: From CNC Machinist to Fullstack Dev
Hero.description: After 34 years at the lathe, I completed the Clarusway full stack bootcamp (2023 to 2025). Today I build web apps with React, Next.js, Node.js and MongoDB.

About.title: About Me
About.imageAlt: A laptop on a desk, my workplace today
About.intro: Today I spend every day at my laptop building web apps, from the frontend to the database.
About.text: From the workshop I brought one rule with me: measure twice, cut once. I plan before I code, check my results and enjoy working in a team.

education.title: Education
education.bootcamp: Full stack bootcamp at Clarusway (2023 to 2025): frontend and backend

blog.title: Milestone-Blog-App
blog.description: Blogging platform with my own backend built on Node.js, Express and MongoDB. After login and registration you can write posts with a preview, edit and delete them, comment and manage your own profile. On the frontend, Redux Toolkit handles state and Formik with Yup handles the forms.

disney.title: Disney+ Clone
disney.description: Movie and series catalogue with TMDB API data, search, a trailer modal and a watchlist stored in the browser.

dashboard.title: Admin Dashboard
dashboard.description: Admin interface with KPIs, data tables, bar, line, pie and map charts, a calendar and PDF export. Built with the Next.js App Router and Material UI.

movie.title: Movie-App
movie.description: Search movies, view details and trailers, with login and registration via Firebase.

netflix.title: Netflix-App
netflix.description: Streaming interface in Next.js with profile selection, movie lists and a trailer section.

stock.title: Stock-App
stock.description: Inventory management for firms, brands, products, purchases and sales. I built the frontend for Clarusway's API: login and registration, validated forms, data tables and a dashboard with KPIs and charts.
